info.name: Pinocchio: Unstrung
info.plot: Influenzato da un Grillo Parlante sinistro e creato da Geppetto, Pinocchio intraprende una violenta crociata per trasformarsi, pezzo dopo pezzo, in un bambino vero come suo fratello Giacomo.

translations.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
translations.tagline: He has no strings to hold him back now.
